verification_method: Snapshot method: values transcribed from dated official Amazon listing snapshots (amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>) supplied for this project on 2026-11-19. A 2026-11-19 re-fetch returned dynamic, option-dependent content and was not used to overwrite values. Seller statements are recorded as claims, not as independently verified measurements. Anything not readable on the snapshot is null and flagged.
note: intended_* fields are the product-intent confirmation record. observed_* fields are the measured redirect target. The two are never merged. intended_* stay null until the owner confirms in the Associates workflow. dp_token_result records an observation only: constructing /dp/<token> from a 9-character token returned Page Not Found on 2026-11-19; that does not test or establish the status of the supplied link.amazon short links (FLG-011).

price_snapshot_note: price_observed fields are archival snapshots dated 2026-11-19. Observation time and delivery location were not recorded; prices are not current offers. See FLG-012.
claim_basis: Specs, ratings, and prices are seller/listing statements from the snapshot. Claim-marked fields (accuracy, certification, response time, heat-safe ratings, function names) are marketing claims the site has not tested. See FLG-009.
citation_policy: Every value rendered on the site must trace to one of: (a) a dated fetch of the official listing, (b) a dated fetch of an official policy page, or (c) arithmetic over (a) that states its inputs. Values with no such trace are left blank and published on flagged.html. See data/citations.json.
